title: The realization–singular unit is a realization weak equivalence
statement: Use simplicial sets, geometric realization, and weak homotopy equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a fixed universe large enough for the sets of continuous maps below. For a topological space $T$, define the singular simplicial set by $\operatorname{Sing}(T)_n=\operatorname{Cont}(|\Delta^n|,T)$, with operators given by precomposition with the affine maps of topological simplices. For every small simplicial set $X$, let $u_X:X\to\operatorname{Sing}(|X|)$ be the simplicial map taking $x\in X_n$ to the continuous characteristic map $t\mapsto[x,t]$ into the quotient realization. Then $|u_X|:|X|\to|\operatorname{Sing}(|X|)|$ induces a bijection on path components and isomorphisms on all based homotopy groups at every basepoint of $|X|$. No Kan, finiteness, connectedness or nonemptiness assumption on $X$ is imposed.

source.place: Theorem 3.6.4.1 (Milnor), Kerodon Tag 0142; Corollary 3.6.4.3, Kerodon Tag 03X7, identifies the geometric-realization convention for weak equivalences. Read online 2026-10-17; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag for this theorem; these are Kerodon tags.
